footerNote: Figures are from Reddit's Q3 2024 earnings release (Exhibit 99.1) and Form 10-Q, which report in thousands. Reddit's tax line was a $0.03M benefit this quarter. Reddit still carries large tax losses from earlier years, so it pays almost no income tax even in a profitable quarter — the tax step is a tiny benefit rather than a bill.

otherDetail: Other income of $23.0M, net — $21.2M of interest income, net, earned on Reddit's $1,745M of cash and marketable securities, plus $1.8M of other income, mainly realized gains and currency moves. Interest income is what lifted a thin $6.9M operating profit to a $29.8M pre-tax profit.

segments.name: Advertising
segments.note: Ads shown across Reddit's communities — powered by more users, more time on site, and better ad targeting.

segments.name: Other revenue
segments.note: Mostly data licensing — deals that let AI companies train on Reddit's public posts — plus Reddit Premium subscriptions. Up more than six-fold from just $5.1M a year ago as the licensing deals kicked in.

takeaways.text: Daily Active Uniques reached 97.2 million, up 47% from 66.0 million a year ago — the audience growth behind the 56% jump in ad revenue, as more people spent more time in Reddit's communities.
takeaways.title: Daily users surged 47%

takeaways.text: Net income was $29.9 million — an 8.6% margin — versus a $7.4 million loss a year ago, Reddit's first profitable quarter since its March 2024 IPO. Operating income itself was a thin $6.9 million; $23.0 million of interest and other income did the rest.
takeaways.title: First GAAP profit as a public company

takeaways.text: Stock-based compensation and related taxes were $83.3 million in the quarter ($74.8 million of stock pay alone) — nearly three times net income and 24% of revenue. That gap is why Adjusted EBITDA of $94.1 million looks so much stronger than the $29.9 million GAAP profit.
takeaways.title: Stock pay still dwarfs the profit

verdict: Reddit's revenue grew 68% to $348M as daily users jumped 47% — and the newly public company posted its first GAAP profit, keeping $29.9M, about 9 cents of every revenue dollar.
